arguments.content: Recovery identity must match the caller's idempotency scope. Selecting the first retained recovery record by resource/workspace merges distinct operations when audit records survive completion; a new operation can falsely succeed without applying its payload or creating its own record. Review with two sequential operation IDs on one resource, including a completed first operation. Keep recovery lookup keyed by operation ID. Verified by a regression check in service.py: HEAD applies the second payload and records op-2; staged code returns success for op-2 while retaining op-1 values only.
